title: USB serial enumeration can exceed caller capacity on multi-interface devices
summary: Fixed and reverified in task 20261024150354-a911-fix-usb-serial-gps-findings. macOS checks capacity before both iterator acquisitions and returns early for nonpositive capacities; metadata/order and owned resource release verified with fake IOKit and real CF values. Independent source review passed; exact command evidence and platform/hardware limits retained in repair reports.
evidence: indigo_usbserial_utils.c:100-111: macOS outer USB loop checks count < num_serial_info, but inner descendant loop writes serial_info[count] and increments for every serial endpoint without checking capacity. A multi-interface device when one slot remains overwrites caller storage. Framework indigo_driver.c:280 supplies a fixed MAX_DEVICE_PORTS array.

resolution.evidence: Task 20261024150354-a911-fix-usb-serial-gps-findings: verified repair and independent review in verification.md, quality-review.md and security.md. Original finding evidence retained; no risk acceptance.
